Verified by vc 2026-09-09 18:05Z at snorkeltoast's source and driven where driving was possible. Landed 7c53c60, +62 lines, one file.

THE MANIFEST CARRIES IT UNCONDITIONALLY, WHICH IS WHY READING IT IS CONCLUSIVE HERE. `"host": host_fingerprint()` is a literal key in capture's manifest dict with no branch and no condition, sitting directly alongside `chrome` and `viewport` -- the two members of the set the row says it belongs to. Every manifest capture writes carries it by construction, so there is no runtime path that omits it.

THE BLOCK'S SHAPE DRIVEN RATHER THAN QUOTED: running the same five primitives here returns {"node": "rhadamanth", "system": "Darwin", "release": "25.6.0", "machine": "arm64", "cpu_count": 16}, matching what snorkeltoast reported without vc taking it from their message.

vc ALSO SEARCHED FOR A REAL MANIFEST AND FOUND ZERO, AND THAT WAS vc'S POPULATION ERROR RATHER THAN A GAP. `find` over the whole Snorkeltoast tree returns NO manifest.json at all, because capture's out_dir is caller-supplied scratch that is rmtree'd and recreated per run and never lands in the repository. The search asked the tree for something that lives outside it. Named here because an empty find is exactly the reading vc's own board says not to take at face value.

BOTH CONSTANTS BOXED, AND THE EXEMPTION IS STATED RATHER THAN SILENT. SHOT_SETTLE_S 0.6 and the ~2s / 90s measurements now carry a paragraph saying they were measured on ONE MACHINE and that until today the file did not say which -- "a slower or more loaded machine moves the first, and a reader who inherits these numbers has no way to tell whether they were ever true where they are standing". SHOT_TIMEOUT_S 45 is DELIBERATELY LEFT ALONE with its reason at the site: it is a ceiling on a hang rather than an estimate of a shot, and a number chosen to be comfortably wrong in the safe direction should not be re-derived from a faster machine. That is the right call and is the difference between a measured constant and a bound.

COMPARE READS THE FIELD, THREE BRANCHES, ALL VERIFIED AT SOURCE, AND THE BLOCK SITS AHEAD OF THE AC-2.16 EXPECTATIONS AND THEREFORE AHEAD OF THE STRUCTURE CHECK. Properties differ: names which keys, prints reference against new for each, and says a floor carried across describes a machine that is not this one. Only `node` differs: says so, and points at the properties beside it as what a pixel difference should be read against, rather than treating a rename as a machine change. Neither side has the block: says the captures predate the host record, so whether they ran on one machine is NOT ESTABLISHED -- which is the honest third state rather than an assumed yes, and it has a real non-empty population arriving immediately, since every capture taken before today lacks the field.

THE ROW'S OTHER HALF WAS ALREADY DISCHARGED BY THE CONSTANT CEASING TO EXIST, measured separately: capture read `budget_for(...) if budget_for else 4000` and now takes no default at all. Every remaining 4000 in the harness was read rather than counted -- two a fixture's ease value, one a selftest case name, six comments recording the history -- and none is a live capture time.

CONVERGE-UNTIL-TWO-FRAMES-AGREE IS NOT SMUGGLED IN BY THIS CLOSURE. It remains undecided on its own merits, it is not in 7c53c60, and vc verified that.
